arxiv-1801-02696.title: Exact moments of the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev model up to order 1 / N 2 1/N^{2}
arxiv-1801-02696.creator: Antonio M. García-García, Yiyang Jia, and Jacobus J. M. Verbaarschot
arxiv-1801-02696.description: Abstract We analytically evaluate the moments of the spectral density of the q q -body Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) model, and obtain order 1 / N 2 1/N^{2} corrections for all moments, where N N is the total number of Majorana fermions. To order 1 / N 1/N , moments are given by those of the weight function of the Q-Hermite polynomials.

arxiv-2201-02703.creator: P. C. López Vázquez, G. Sánchez-González, J. Martínez-Ortega, R. S. Arroyo-Duarte

arxiv-2210-12120.title: Optimisation of the SVOM satellite strategy for the rapid follow-up of gravitational wave events 2022 Optimisation of the SVOM satellite strategy for the rapid follow-up of gravitational wave events – References
arxiv-2210-12120.creator: J. -G. Ducoin, B. Desoubrie, F. Daigne, N. Leroy
arxiv-2210-12120.description: Abstract The SVOM satellite, to be launched in early 2024, is primarily devoted to the multi-wavelength observation of gamma-ray bursts and other higher-energy transients. Thanks to its onboard Microchannel X-ray Telescope and Visible-band Telescope, it is also very well adapted to the electromagnetic follow-up of gravitational wave events.

arxiv-2304-07353.title: CYLINDRICALLY SYMMETRIC FIELDS IN GENERAL RELATIVITY
arxiv-2304-07353.creator: N. O. Santos, Anzhong Wang
arxiv-2304-07353.description: Abstract We present a brief review of exact solutions of cylindrical symmetric fields in General Relativity produced by different perfect fluid sources. These sources are assumed static, stationary, translating and collapsing. Properties of these fields are discussed and some important open questions are called the attention for future research.

arxiv-2411-09233.title: Angle of Null Energy Condition Lines in Critical Spacetimes
arxiv-2411-09233.creator: Christian Ecker, Florian Ecker, Daniel Grumiller
arxiv-2411-09233.description: Abstract We identify a new critical parameter in Choptuik’s gravitational collapse: the angle at which null energy condition (NEC) saturation lines intersect at the center of the critical spacetime. These NEC lines coincide with regions of vanishing curvature, dividing spacetime into stripes of positive and negative curvature.

arxiv-2506-03025.title: Bivariate polynomial histopolation techniques on Padua, Fekete and Leja triangles
arxiv-2506-03025.creator: Ludovico Bruni Bruno, Francesco Dell’Accio, Wolfgang Erb, Federico Nudo
arxiv-2506-03025.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Ludovico Bruni Bruno, Francesco Dell’Accio, Wolfgang Erb, Federico Nudo. This paper explores the reconstruction of a real-valued function f f defined over a domain Ω ⊂ ℝ 2 \Omega\subset\mathbb{R}^{2} using bivariate polynomials that satisfy triangular histopolation conditions. More precisely, we assume that only the averages of f f over a given triangulation 𝒯 N \mathcal{T}_{N} of Ω \Omega are available and seek a bivariate polynomial that approximates f f using a histopolation approach, potentially flanked by an additional regression technique.

Very little is known, however, about the role of experience in the early development of striatal networks which regulate both motor and cognitive functi

pmc-10593749.title: Wearable sensor and machine learning estimate tendon load and walking speed during immobilizing boot ambulation
pmc-10593749.creator: Michelle P. Kwon, Todd J. Hullfish, Casey Jo Humbyrd, Lorraine A. T. Boakye, Josh R. Baxter
pmc-10593749.description: The purpose of this study is to develop a wearable paradigm to accurately monitor Achilles tendon loading and walking speed using wearable sensors that reduce subject burden. Ten healthy adults walked in an immobilizing boot under various heel wedge conditions (30°, 5°, 0°) and walking speeds.

pmc-10661499.title: Arthroscopic Lysis of Adhesions for Stiffness After Surgical Management of Proximal Humerus Fractures Leads to Satisfactory Outcomes in Most Patients
pmc-10661499.creator: Javier Ardebol, Nicholas A. Zuk, Ali Īhsan Kiliç, Theresa Pak, Mariano E. Menendez, Patrick J. Denard
pmc-10661499.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). PurposeTo report patient-reported outcomes (PROs), range of motion (ROM), and satisfaction, in patients who underwent arthroscopic lysis of adhesions for stiffness after open reduction with internal fixation (ORIF) or reverse shoulder arthroplasty (RSA) for fracture.MethodsA retrospective review was performed to identify patients with stiffness who underwent arthroscopic lysis of adhesions following ORIF or RSA for proximal humerus fracture at a single institution between 2012 and 2021 with minimum 1-year follow-up.

pmc-11339373.title: In-depth analysis of transcriptomes in ovarian cortical follicles from children and adults reveals interfollicular heterogeneity
pmc-11339373.creator: Ilmatar Rooda, Jasmin Hassan, Jie Hao, Magdalena Wagner, Elisabeth Moussaud-Lamodière, Kersti Jääger, Marjut Otala, Katri Knuus, Cecilia Lindskog, Kiriaki Papaikonomou, Sebastian Gidlöf, Cecilia Langenskiöld, Hartmut Vogt, Per Frisk, Johan Malmros, Timo Tuuri, Andres Salumets, Kirsi Jahnukainen, Agn
pmc-11339373.description: The ovarian cortical reserve of follicles is vital for fertility. Some medical treatments are toxic to follicles, leading to premature ovarian insufficiency. Ovarian tissue cryopreservation is an established method to preserve fertility in adults and even applied in prepuberty despite unproven efficacy. Here, we analyze transcriptomes of 120 cortical follicles from children and adults for detailed comparison.

pmc-11371759.title: Performance of metagenomic Next-Generation Sequencing and metagenomic Nanopore Sequencing for the diagnosis of tuberculosis in HIV-positive patients
pmc-11371759.creator: Jing Yuan, Lanchun Wang, Wei Zhang, Changgang Deng, Qisui Li, Yamin Meng, Yaokai Chen
pmc-11371759.description: BackgroundPatients who were infected by the Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV) could have weakened immunity that is complicated by opportunistic infections, especially for Mycobacterium tuberculosis (MTB). Notably, the HIV-MTB co-infection will accelerate the course of disease progress and greatly increase the mortality of patients.

pmc-11657653.title: Once-weekly semaglutide doubles the five-year risk of nonarteritic anterior ischemic optic neuropathy in a Danish cohort of 424,152 persons with type 2 diabetes
pmc-11657653.creator: Jakob Grauslund, Andreas Abou Taha, Laleh Dehghani Molander, Ryo Kawasaki, Sören Möller, Kurt Højlund, Lonny Stokholm
pmc-11657653.description: BackgroundNonarteritic anterior ischemic optic neuropathy (NAION) is an untreatable condition often causing severe and irreversible visual loss in the affected eye. As it has recently been implied that the use of semaglutide associates with NAION, the aim of the present study was to evaluate this risk prospectively in all persons with type 2 diabetes (T2D) in Denmark.

pmc-11689089.title: ADVERSE CHILDHOOD EXPERIENCES AND DEMENTIA AMONG OLDER US ADULTS: ASSESSMENT OF GENDER AND RACIAL DISPARITIES
pmc-11689089.creator: Monique Brown
pmc-11689089.description: Six in ten US adults report exposure to adverse childhood experiences (ACEs). However, their effects on health outcomes are seen across the life course. ACEs have been linked to cognitive impairment. However, less is known about the association between ACEs and a dementia diagnosis. In addition, gender and racial disparities may exist in this relationship.

pmc-12438383.title: Network Analysis of Symptom Structures in Autism, Schizophrenia, and Non-Diagnosed Controls
pmc-12438383.creator: S. Holka, D. Sörnyei, Á. Vass, K. Farkas
pmc-12438383.description: IntroductionDespite differences in the onset and symptomatology, Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) and Schizophrenia (SCH) are neurodevelopmental conditions with evolving conceptual links in modern psychiatry. This stems from increasing evidence suggesting overlap in social cognition, attachment and the conceptualization as disorders of the self.

pmc-12721322.title: Design of orthogonal and portable RNA devices for post-transcriptional regulation by reverse engineering type I toxin-antitoxin systems
pmc-12721322.creator: Guobin Yin, Luyao Zhang, Di Zhou, Siyan Zhou, Ruirui Xu, Guocheng Du, Jian Chen, Zhen Kang
pmc-12721322.description: Type I toxin-antitoxin (TA) systems are widely distributed in the prokaryotic world, known for their antitoxin RNA interfering with the cognate toxin mRNA translation. Beyond their canonical role in plasmid maintenance, these systems represent evolutionarily optimized regulatory modules with rapid kinetics and modular architectures. Here, we repurposed them as post-transcriptional regulatory RNA devices via reverse engineering.

pmc-13077291.title: A Case Study and Review of the Literature on IgA Nephropathy in Crohn's Disease
pmc-13077291.creator: Giovanna Fernanda Vazzana, Alessia Romano, Chiara Casuscelli, Alberto La Spada, Domenico Santoro, Roberto Chimenz, Claudio Romano
pmc-13077291.description: IgA nephropathy (IgAN) is the most frequently reported glomerular disease associated with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), particularly Crohn's disease (CD), although pediatric cases remain rare. We report IgAN in a 16‐year‐old male with CD following intestinal surgery and during long‐term infliximab therapy, with renal impairment occurring independently of bowel disease activity.

pmc-13469087.title: Semi-automated detection of cleaning interactions using supervised machine learning
pmc-13469087.creator: Raul Oliveira, Nuno Cruz Garcia, José Ricardo Paula
pmc-13469087.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Cleaner fish engage in mutualistic interactions by removing ectoparasites from client species, a behaviour that has traditionally been quantified through labour-intensive manual video analysis. This method is not only time-consuming but also susceptible to human error and bias. In this study, we developed a semi-automated system to track and classify cleaning interactions between the cleaner wrasse (Labroides dimidiatus) and the powder blue tang (Acanthurus leucosternon) in a controlled three-dimensional laboratory setting.

pmc-13482804.title: Single cell multiomics unravel the transcription networks controlling the different EMT tumor states
pmc-13482804.creator: Andrea Pérez-González, Gabriel Windels, Kevin Bévant, Justine Lengrand, Sophie Lemaire, Virginie Moers, Samuel Scozzaro, Ulysse Debroux, Christine Dubois, Sebastiaan Vanuytven, Cédric Blanpain
pmc-13482804.description: Epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition (EMT) is a dynamic process during which cells lose their epithelial characteristics and acquire mesenchymal traits. In cancer, EMT is closely associated with tumor initiation, progression, invasion, metastasis, and therapy resistance. Rather than being a binary state switch, EMT encompasses a spectrum of tumor states with distinct functional properties.

pmc-13502667.title: Iterative Synthesis of Pyrene–Coronene Molecular Graphene Nanoribbons
pmc-13502667.creator: Miguel A. Medel, Guanzhao Wen, Adrián Morón‐Blanco, Mischa Bonn, Hai I. Wang, Manuel Melle‐Franco, Aurelio Mateo‐Alonso

pmc-13571610.title: A Literature Review of Immunotherapeutics in the Management of Adult B-Cell Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia
pmc-13571610.creator: Tamer Othman, Ibrahim Aldoss
pmc-13571610.description: Relapsed/refractory (R/R) B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia (B-ALL) has historically been associated with poor outcomes in adults treated with conventional chemotherapy. Allogeneic hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) in second remission has been the only strategy associated with durable remissions and potential cure.
